data.title: 诱宵美九 · 晨光真丝床榻的极乐崇拜
data.description: 清晨的薄光透过落地窗洒在奢华大床上，薄纱睡裙散落一旁。美九眼角泛着极致欢愉的泪花，十指紧紧深扣达令的双掌，在滚烫颠簸中一遍遍呼唤着达令的名字永远爱你。
data.location: sunlit penthouse master bed with lavender silk sheets
data.action: tangled in messy sheets, sheer nightgown pushed aside, interlocking fingers with partner, weeping tears of pure ecstasy, flushed body
data.lighting: radiant golden morning sunlight streaming across lavender sheets
data.mood: transcendent idol ecstasy, total emotional worship, heavenly bridal bliss
data.promptProse: Tangled in lavender silk sheets in golden morning light, Miku Izayoi sheds tears of ecstasy, interlocked fingers tight in passionate surrender.
data.animaCaption: Miku Izayoi crying sweet tears of ecstasy in messy morning sheets.
